channel.title: GroundYield Updates
channel.description: Public progress updates from the GroundYield modular farm pilot in Vilanculos, Mozambique.

item.title: Why others failed + theft control design
item.description: WHY_OTHERS_FAILED.md maps historical failure modes (Mosagrius-type waves, land deals, NGO tech drops, markets, training). SECURITY_THEFT.md is the control plan for panels/pumps/crime. SOURCES.md cites Energypedia/Practica theft barriers and Ecology & Society frontier literature. No claim of immunity.

item.title: Community deal + money model (VALUE_AND_MONEY)
item.description: Why communities engage, household benefits and risks, capital protection, ownership models A–D, and how next villages get funded without extraction or fake charity math.

item.title: Portuguese site review — pt.html honesty parity
item.description: Audit of PT surfaces. pt.html rebuilt to match EN critical honesty (0 units, Rumbacaca, operator loss disclosure, AI freeze). PT.md was already ahead. Deep docs stay EN.

item.title: Master open plan consolidated (PLAN.md)
item.description: PLAN.md is the master open plan: phases with exits, risks, doc map, Rumbacaca return, Starlink/AI, honest status (0 units). README/PT/homepage aligned. Field execution is the remaining gap.

item.title: Operator history: prior Vilanculos scale farming failure
item.description: Jacques discloses ~3500ha era, Toro partnership scale, exit after COVID costs and bad choices, ~ZAR 10m loss (E). Not current land control. Return to Rumbacaca. Modular open pilot is the opposite bet.

item.title: SYSTEM.md — physical units, Starlink hubs, AI roles
item.description: Operating model: farm package is core; Starlink school hubs first; AI for ops now and reviewed advice later. Neither tech replaces baselines or land. G5 freeze stands.

item.title: Starlink approach: rural schools first (no promises yet)
item.description: School-first satellite connectivity pilot concept (1–3 sites). Email draft to Starlink Business. Power, ownership, and no community promises until written path. No agreement yet.

item.title: Local businesses contact list for Vilanculos trip
item.description: Desk list: hardware, agro-inputs, lodge/restaurant offtake, extension, Maputo national, SA corridor. First-15 walk-ins. Not quotes — verify in person.

item.title: Ground window next ~2 weeks + X field post pack
item.description: Provisional ground window ~27 Jul–10 Aug 2026 (SA→ZW→Vilanculos). X_FIELD_2WEEKS daily note templates. Still zero units and baselines. Day-1 thread + leaving posts ready to publish.

item.title: Big-wins board: quote requests, trip scenarios, X follow-ups
item.description: NEXT.md ranked wins + 7-day sprint. QUOTE_REQUESTS.md ready emails for G2. Trip scenarios A/B/C. X_FOLLOWUPS after Day-1 thread. Desk ready; human outbound is the bottleneck.

item.title: Asset re-verify, one-pager PDF fix, supplier desk leads
item.description: OG/favicon/icons confirmed 200 + magic bytes. One-pager PDF was base64-corrupted — fixed to real PDF. live-verify checks binary magic. SUPPLIERS desk leads only (no prices).

item.title: Next board, day1.html essay page, PT launch, contact log
item.description: NEXT.md operator board for G1/G2. Shareable day1.html. Portuguese launch blurb. CONTACT_LOG for outreach without private numbers. Paper complete; human outreach is next.

item.title: Launch pack: honesty-first OUTREACH, X thread, day-one blog
item.description: OUTREACH.md, X_THREAD_DAY1.md (8 posts), BLOG_DAY1.md. Lead with unproven stage and AI disclosure, not yield %. Post only after ship-check.

item.title: Ops rails: public unit registry (0), CI, ship-check, outreach
item.description: units.html shows count 0 until real installs. GitHub CI runs data checks. ship-check.sh gates live claims. Outreach email templates and field gates G0–G6 published.

item.title: Correction: early shipped claims + charter targets aspirational
item.description: Append-only correction: day-one live claims outran HTTP 200s (fixed). Charter yield/unit numbers are design aims not results. Agronomy WhatsApp freeze. WHO runway/stop gap named. Zero field units/baselines by honest status.

item.title: Integrity & anti-fraud — top policy from day one
item.description: INTEGRITY.md: fight ghost units, fake baselines, cherry-picked yields, procurement abuse, impostors. Charter #6, homepage section, dual evidence for headline claims, public challenge path.

item.title: Trip ops — budget, safety, packing, partnership draft
item.description: TRIP_BUDGET, SAFETY, packing list, daily log, buyer interview, UNIT_AGREEMENT_DRAFT (not a contract), and scripts/check-data.sh. Travel dates still open.

item.title: Field kit — offline ops pack + printable forms
item.description: Interview scripts, consent card, baseline form, quote CSV, WhatsApp pocket copy, and 4-page printable field forms PDF. Master index: field/FIELD_KIT.md. Trip dates and budget still open.

item.title: Vercel Git connected to groundyield/website
item.description: Production linked to github.com/groundyield/website main (not the sluiper fork). Full-tree deploys verified live including OG image, icons, favicon, and field PDF. Partial uploads remain banned.

item.title: Field one-pager PDF (EN+PT offline handout)
item.description: Printable two-page EN+PT handout for ground contact without internet. Local baseline framing, planning cost band, named accountability, no ask for money on first meeting. field/

item.title: Irrigation options + live-verify script
item.description: IRRIGATION.md: per-unit kit vs shared headworks. scripts/live-verify.sh automates the DEPLOY.md URL checklist. Site documents list links IRRIGATION + DEPLOY.

item.title: Deploy process locked in docs
item.description: DEPLOY.md: Git → Vercel as the only supported production path; live-verify checklist; explicit ban on partial uploads. (Git connect completed later the same day.)

item.title: Portuguese page, supplier template, advice scripts
item.description: On-site Portuguese landing (/pt.html), SUPPLIERS.md quote log, ADVICE_SCRIPTS.md WhatsApp PT templates. Operator notification path confirmed.

item.title: Jacques Theron named as founder / operator
item.description: Public accountability: Jacques Theron listed as founder and operator of GroundYield in WHO.md and on the website.

item.title: Trust layer, Portuguese summary, cited yield range
item.description: Social share image, accountability rules in WHO.md, PT.md, CONSENT, CONTRIBUTING, SOURCES. Maize yield range cited. UNIT cost band ~$1.3–3k.

item.title: Unit design stack: BOM, economics, season, AI, partnerships
item.description: Public v0 docs for modular unit BOM, illustrative economics, crop calendar, AI agronomy design, and community partnership principles.

item.title: Public launch — foundation phase begins
item.description: Public launch complete. Plan, Charter and Data standards published. Foundation phase. Trip planned: South Africa → Zimbabwe → Mozambique.
